Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000673": The Cinder team observed on 2025-09-03 that the authentication gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: authentication gateway, runtime upgrade, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000668" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-03, the product catalog can be released on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays; the previous Mon-Thu 09:00-17:00 UTC slot no longer applies.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000666" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-03, the product catalog can be deployed on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000634" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-15, the Boreal team says to page Marcus for anything this cycle, not Lena Fischer.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000610": Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle as of 2025-07-30.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman)
- memory_id "1000594": On 2025-07-30, on-call for the Atlas team passed from Tomasz to Priya Raman when Tomasz moved to the Dune team.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000567": Diego has the Cinder pager as of 2025-07-17, taking over from Yuki Tanaka.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000563": On 2025-07-17, Yuki Tanaka handed the Cinder pager to Diego on rotation day.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000548": Yuki Tanaka runs the monthly cost review.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, monthly cost review)
- memory_id "1000438" [decision]: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, when ownership passed from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000430": As of 2025-05-15, the pager for webhooks rings the Boreal team instead of the Ember team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000417" [decision]: Cinder adopted trunk-based development as of 2025-05-14.  (about: Cinder)
- memory_id "1000412": The Cinder team observed on 2025-05-14 that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher, cache change)
- memory_id "1000378": The Cinder team reported on 2025-04-24 that feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Cinder, feature-flags, Tuesday's deploy)
- memory_id "1000306" [constraint]: For anything Ember-related, page Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000158": The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000112": Cinder owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000085": Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year.  (about: Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000026": Diego is on Cinder.  (about: Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka is on Cinder.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder)
Existing entity names: authentication gateway, runtime upgrade, Cinder team, product catalog, Boreal team, Lena, Marcus, Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz, Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego, monthly cost review, indexer, webhook dispatcher, Ember team, cache change, feature-flags, Tuesday's deploy, Oskar
